text: Sugu ɓen gomɗimɓe wiŋtirooɓe jawle maɓɓe ɗen e laawol Alla, no wa'i wano abbere fuɗnunde -e leydi moƴƴiri- gawƴe jeeɗiɗi, hara no e gawƴol kala gabbe teemeredere. Alla No Sowana baraaji on Mo O Muuyi e jayaaɓe Makko ɓen; O Yoɓitiraɓe ko aldaa e hasboore. Alla Ko Yaajuɗo ɓural e dokkal, Annduɗo ɓen haanduɓe e ɗum.
